UC-01.en: Safe workspace. Clauseo works inside this matter's folder and asks before going beyond it.
UC-01.hi: सुरक्षित कार्यक्षेत्र। Clauseo इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर के भीतर काम करता है और उससे बाहर जाने से पहले पूछता है।

UC-03.en: Clauseo asks before each change in this matter.
UC-03.hi: Clauseo इस मामले में हर बदलाव से पहले पूछता है।

UC-04.en: Clauseo can change files in this matter without asking. It asks before going beyond it.

UC-05.en: Clauseo can reach beyond this matter's folder without asking.
UC-05.hi: Clauseo बिना पूछे इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर से बाहर पहुँच सकता है।

UC-10.en: Windows asks once for permission to set up the Safe workspace.
UC-10.hi: सुरक्षित कार्यक्षेत्र तैयार करने के लिए Windows एक बार अनुमति माँगता है।

UC-11.en: Windows will ask if you want to allow changes, and it may show the publisher as unknown. That's expected. Choose Yes to set up protection.

UC-14.en: Choose Yes in the window Windows shows.
UC-14.hi: Windows जो विंडो दिखाता है, उसमें Yes चुनें।

UC-15.hi: सुरक्षित कार्यक्षेत्र तैयार हो रहा है।

UC-21.en: Protection is off for {matter}. Clauseo can read and change files anywhere on this computer while it works here, without asking first.
UC-21.hi: {matter} के लिए संरक्षण बंद है। यहाँ काम करते समय Clauseo बिना पहले पूछे इस कंप्यूटर पर कहीं भी फ़ाइलें पढ़ और बदल सकता है।

UC-22.en: Protection isn't set up on this computer yet. Until it is, Clauseo can read any file on this computer, and asks before changing anything outside this matter's folder.

UC-23.en: Protection couldn't be set up on this computer, so Clauseo can read any file on it. It asks before changing anything outside this matter's folder.

UC-24.en: Windows didn't allow the protected space on this computer.
UC-24.hi: Windows ने इस कंप्यूटर पर संरक्षित स्थान की अनुमति नहीं दी।

UC-25.en: This computer can't give Clauseo's protection, so Clauseo can read any file on it. It asks before changing anything outside this matter's folder.

UC-26.en: Every change inside the matter's folder is still kept, and Versions can undo it.
UC-26.hi: मामले के फ़ोल्डर के भीतर हर बदलाव अब भी रखा जाता है, और संस्करण उसे पूर्ववत कर सकते हैं।

UC-27.en: All {size} of this computer's protected spaces are in use, so this matter works without protection for now. It's protected again once one is free.

UC-28.en: In use by other open matters: {n}

UC-29.en: Kept by matters with nothing open: {n}

UC-30.en: Freed the next time Clauseo starts work: {n}

UC-32.en: To free one now, end a conversation in another matter.

UC-33.en: Windows policy on this computer doesn't let Clauseo's protection accounts sign in. Ask your IT team to add them to the Allow log on locally policy.

UC-34.en: Clauseo can add room for 4 more. Windows asks for permission first.

UC-36.en: Clauseo's protection isn't available on Windows on ARM yet, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-37.en: This build of Clauseo comes without protection, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-38.en: This build of Clauseo comes without protection, so Clauseo can read any file on this computer. It asks before changing anything outside this matter's folder.

UC-42.en: Windows will ask if you want to allow changes, and it may show the publisher as unknown. That's expected. Choose Yes to remove protection's set-up.

UC-43.en: Afterwards, Clauseo works on this computer without protection until you set it up again.

UC-50.en: Your firm requires protection on this computer. Set it up once, then ask here.

UC-51.en: Your firm requires protection, and all of this computer's protected spaces are in use, so Clauseo can't answer here yet. End a conversation in another matter to free one.

UC-61.en: Clauseo can't show this computer's protection here yet.

UC-63.en: macOS keeps Clauseo inside each matter's folder.

UC-64.en: Windows keeps Clauseo inside each matter's folder.

UC-67.en: Protection isn't set up on this computer yet, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-68.en: Windows didn't allow the set-up, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-69.en: Set up on {date}, with Windows' permission.
UC-69.hi: {date} को Windows की अनुमति से सेट किया गया।

UC-70.en: Protection couldn't be set up on this computer, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-71.en: This computer can't give Clauseo's protection, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-72.en: Clauseo's protection isn't available on Linux yet, so Clauseo asks before changing anything outside a matter's folder.

UC-74.en: Your firm requires protection, so Clauseo doesn't answer on this computer until it's protected.

UC-76.en: Your firm doesn't allow Clauseo to work without asking on this computer.
